heading.title: PROPORTION WHO THINK THEY SEE TOO MUCH NEWS ON EACH NETWORK – UK

figures.source_line: Q12_Social_rightsize ... Do you think that the amount of content you see from news outlets on <social network>. is too much, about right, or not enough? Base: All that use each social network: Facebook = 1501, Twitter = 685, Instagram = 859, TikTok = 270.

heading.title: PROPORTION WHO SAW FALSE OR MISLEADING INFORMATION ABOUT EACH TOPIC IN THE LAST WEEK – SELECTED REGIONS

figures.source_line: Q. FAKE_NEWS 2021a. Have you seen false or misleading information about any of the following topics, in the last week? Base: Total sample in each region: Europe = 48,836, North America = 4048, Asia = 20,349, Latin America = 12,104, Africa = 6057. Note: Africa average is Kenya, South Africa, and Nigeria only (English speakers in South Africa and Nigeria).

new_components.name: bar_track_background
new_components.evidence: every bar drawn inside a light grey full-length track ending at the plot right edge
new_components.why_it_matters: 灰色轨道看似满值参考条，读数时须以彩色部分末端而非轨道长度为准，否则会误判比例。

new_components.name: repeated_category_across_panels
new_components.evidence: 'Australia' appears once under Twitter (23%) and again under Facebook (20%)
new_components.why_it_matters: 同名行出现两次，必须用所属平台分组名一起定位，否则23%与20%无法区分。

new_components.name: value_axis_absent_full_scale_stack
new_components.evidence: stacks reach one common top with no 0–100% axis printed anywhere
new_components.why_it_matters: 百分比只能靠标注文字读取，无法从像素高度校验，缺标注段即不可读。

difficulty_notes: 三张图的数字都直接印在图上，读数不成问题（无刻度轴反而使像素读取无从下手，但标注齐全）。真正的障碍是定位：f3的每个值需要

新组件 repeated_category_across_panels（同名类别在不同分组中重复）
